metadata.description: Manual overrides for scenario × theme cells where historical basket composition diverges meaningfully from today's thematic exposure. With behavioral macro scenarios, fewer cells require override since the scenarios themselves have ample historical analogues.
metadata.rules: Each cell specifies expected_return and volatility as decimals. Cells listed here will NOT be recalibrated from historical data; the calibration script writes these values directly and sets source='manual_override' in the CSV.

grid_power_infrastructure.rationale: Grid/power names are now AI infrastructure proxies; historical industrial contractor returns understate their current AI capex sensitivity in a growth scare with AI concerns.

electrical_equipment.rationale: Same as grid/power — modern thesis tied to AI data center buildout.

high_beta_ai_semis.rationale: Direct exposure to AI capex; historical semi performance in growth scares understates current AI concentration.

grid_power_infrastructure.rationale: Grid/power names would be hit on both credit channel (leverage) and AI capex channel.

high_beta_ai_semis.rationale: Direct AI capex exposure plus broad equity beta in a credit-led recession.
